item.title: Jaymz Bee’s Caravan - Blast Toronto
item.description: Jaymz Bee’s Caravan of Music Returns in 2026 for Its Biggest Edition Yet140+ Musicians, 12 Rooms, One Unforgettable Night in Support of the Unison FundJaymz Bee’s Caravan of Music returns to Old Mill Toronto on Monday, April 13, 2026, for its biggest event to date. After more than ten years of birthday fundraisers, this year’s celebration brings together 24 bands and over 140 musicians performing simultaneously in 12 rooms, all in support of the Unison Fund.

item.title: Grinding Ted Axe! - Blast Toronto
item.description: Recently I was able to sit down with Ted Axe, who dark persona has everyone wondering who this Rock and Roll Vampire is. Well, he may be dark on the outside, but just wait to you hear what he has on the inside. Let’s kick back and hold a mirror up to this long time performer and see what kind of reflections come back to haunt us.

item.title: Sub Sessions 14 - Blast Toronto
item.description: BSMT254 was host to another successful Sub-Sessions event and a day after St Patrick’s Day! People still wanted to go out and explore live music. Well, this is an ongoing event that you should attend at least once to see what the buzz is all about.This time Danny who runs these events put together a 90’s style Alt Rock line-up and here are the results I saw from the front row.

item.title: The Inaugural CANADIAN BLUES MUSIC AWARDS Gala - Blast Toronto
item.description: TORONTO – MONDAY, MARCH 16, 2026 – The Canadian Blues Music Awards (CBMAs) is pleased to announce the GALA for its 2026 awards, presented this year by the Toronto Blues Society. item.title: Introducing Nimkii - Blast Toronto
item.description: This is taken from Wikipedia- Nimkii and the Niniis are a Canadian First Nations musical group from Wiikwemkoong, Ontario,[1] whose debut EP Nang Giizhigoong was a Juno Award nominee for Traditional Indigenous Artist of the Year at the Juno Awards of 2022.[2]

item.title: Getting Punked at the Monarch! - Blast Toronto
item.description: The Monarch Tavern was the place to lose your hearing as well as your mind. There were three acts going at top speed to gain your attention. The place was packed and the crowd was anxious to get things rolling.

item.title: BIG BLUE 2026 NORTH AMERICAN TOUR PRESS RELEASE - Blast Toronto
item.description: After two back-to-back U.S. Tours spanning coast to coast in the latter half of 2025, Edmonton, Alberta rockers Sparrow Blue announce their largest tour yet; the “Big Blue 2026 North American Tour”. The band is embarking on an extensive 6-week tour spanning the U.S. & Canada, with a stop at the legendary Noble Street Studios in Toronto to work on their upcoming third LP. item.title: The 1st Canadian Blues Music Awards - Blast Toronto
item.description: Well, we completed the first chapter of this new Blues award ceremony. The house was packed with everybody who loves the blues. It was filled with both musicians and music industry people and of course the fans who were trying to guess who each of the winners were going to be in each category. I can tell you this, it was not easy and I was surprised by some of the winners.

item.title: March Mayhem! - Blast Toronto
item.description: Neurotic Entertainment is well known for promoting the local Metal scene in Ontario. Well, this time it was a brutal assault of five intense bands. Karina has a wild way of putting together bands that will fit your style of Metal and leave you exhausted by the end of the night. I would know, I went to this event and slept really well after rocking hard to all these bands.
